alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 24 at 11:37AM PST until November 24 at 12:00PM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
Dense fog is not expected this afternoon in the San Joaquin Valley.
Therefore, the Advisory will be allowed to expire.
